title: How Tourists Book China's 350 km/h Bullet Trains (2026) | China Travel Expert
description:
China's bullet trains hit 350 km/h — and in 2026 you can board one with just your passport. Here's how tourists do it.

China runs the world's largest high-speed network — over 45,000 km of track — so Beijing to Shanghai (about 1,300 km) takes only 4.5 to 6 hours. Book on the official 12306 app: foreigners can now register with a passport (an email works — no Chinese phone number needed), choose "Foreign Passport," and pay with a Visa, Mastercard, JCB, or a linked Alipay/WeChat. Tickets open 14 days before travel. At the station there's no paper ticket — you just tap your passport at the orange gate.

🧭 Expert Tip: Book on the official 12306 app, not a markup reseller, and set travel dates exactly 14 days out when tickets drop. Arrive 40 minutes early — Chinese rail stations are airport-sized with security.
